title: Inverse Density Problem for Linear Elasticity: Uniqueness from Local Measurements on a Partially Accessible Boundary
summary: We consider the inverse boundary value problem in an elasticity system. It is proved that the density function $ρ$ and its derivatives at the boundary can be uniquely determined from the local Cauchy data. Furthermore, if the density function is analytic, we can uniquely determine the internal buried objects, as well as the unknown boundary and the boundary conditions imposed on it.
